scope: Member, counselor, employer, partner, admin, shared portal and entry page files. Includes compatibility redirects. Source inventory is not functional acceptance.

focusCases.title: Resume · Files
focusCases.checks: Upload a real test resume. Switch views and return. Download the original and a revised copy; check that existing application snapshots are unchanged.

focusCases.title: Resume · Score
focusCases.checks: Choose or paste a resume, score it, and reopen the saved result. Confirm the selected source and score history.

focusCases.title: Resume · Rewrite
focusCases.checks: Enter a draft, change views, return, and confirm the draft survives. Generate and download a revised copy without replacing the original.

focusCases.title: Resume · Coach
focusCases.checks: Open coaching for the selected resume. Check its source label, provider failure/retry and return to Files.

focusCases.title: Career path · Interests
focusCases.checks: Complete or open saved interests, inspect suggested occupations, and continue to Skill Mapper.

focusCases.title: Career path · O*NET and graph
focusCases.checks: Look up an occupation. Check O*NET identity/source, skills, related occupations, graph/list controls and a saved run. Continue to Training Bridge from that exact run.

focusCases.title: Career path · Training Bridge
focusCases.checks: Open from a saved Skill Mapper result. Confirm the occupation and source, distinguish occupation evidence from personal proficiency, then review the program/curriculum handoff. A bad result ID must not select another run.

focusCases.title: Interview practice · Choose a format
focusCases.checks: Open each offered interview mode. Verify written, voice and coaching labels match the actual tool, and histories still open.

focusCases.title: My program · Learning handoff
focusCases.checks: Open assigned training, the Learning Hub and provider launch. Confirm enrollment, progress and prerequisite gates remain accurate.

focusCases.title: Messages · Human counselor
focusCases.checks: Confirm the destination is the human counselor conversation, separate from the AI Advisor. Use test accounts for any send.

focusCases.title: Today · Needs attention
focusCases.checks: Check the same scoped members and reasons, counts, partial-load warning and per-member actions. Open a record and return to this view.

focusCases.title: Today · By priority
focusCases.checks: Compare urgency ordering and row actions with the legacy triage URL.

focusCases.title: Today · At-risk cases
focusCases.checks: Check risk reasons, filters and member access. Reopen the guided tour and its at-risk step.

focusCases.title: Today · Inactive members
focusCases.checks: Check scoped members, inactivity windows and contact details. Use a designated test record to check outreach success and failure feedback.

focusCases.title: Today · Awaiting reply
focusCases.checks: Open the waiting member thread. Check unread/reply-age counts and message actions without combining notification counts.

focusCases.title: Today · Decisions
focusCases.checks: Review application and intake actions with authorized test records. Check decision feedback and oldest-first order.

focusCases.title: Today · Follow-up
focusCases.checks: Prepare a follow-up, record a test contact, and verify the next handoff/status.

focusCases.title: Today · Overview
focusCases.checks: Check caseload, sessions and activity. Verify all old overview links still reach their tools.

focusCases.title: Students · Roster
focusCases.checks: Filter, sort and page the roster; open a member and return with the same search, filters and page.

focusCases.title: Students · Manage
focusCases.checks: Check program/status/partner/date/staff filters, selected rows, bulk actions and matching CSV export. Use test records for writes.

focusCases.title: Students · Training
focusCases.checks: Check curriculum, provider coverage, pace and unmatched records. Verify progress definitions match the existing view.

focusCases.title: Students · Interview ready
focusCases.checks: Check interview eligibility and its evidence. Verify the old interview-ready link still works.

focusCases.title: Students · Training 70%+
focusCases.checks: Check training completion separately from interview eligibility. Verify the old job-ready link still works.

focusCases.title: Reporting · overview
focusCases.checks: Check selected period, population, definitions and download context. Compare on-screen totals with the matching export, accounting for distinct metric definitions.

focusCases.title: Reporting · outcomes
focusCases.checks: Check selected period, population, definitions and download context. Compare on-screen totals with the matching export, accounting for distinct metric definitions.

focusCases.title: Reporting · training
focusCases.checks: Check selected period, population, definitions and download context. Compare on-screen totals with the matching export, accounting for distinct metric definitions.

focusCases.title: Reporting · coursera
focusCases.checks: Check selected period, population, definitions and download context. Compare on-screen totals with the matching export, accounting for distinct metric definitions.

focusCases.title: Reporting · exports
focusCases.checks: Check selected period, population, definitions and download context. Compare on-screen totals with the matching export, accounting for distinct metric definitions.

focusCases.title: Jobs · Post and import
focusCases.checks: Check Post and Import on phone and desktop. Open full, quick and import flows; confirm draft/pending counts and return filters.

focusCases.title: Candidates · Applicants
focusCases.checks: Filter by job/status and open an application. Check evidence, status actions, pagination and return context.

focusCases.title: Candidates · Matches
focusCases.checks: Review AI suggestions for the chosen posting. Keep suggested matches distinct from submitted applications and preserve filters.

focusCases.title: Candidates · Pipeline
focusCases.checks: Move an authorized test candidate through a hiring stage. Check mobile alternatives, feedback, persistence and the candidate detail return.

focusCases.title: Impact · Outcomes
focusCases.checks: Check the period, population and placement definition. Compare with the old Outcomes URL.

focusCases.title: Impact · Milestones
focusCases.checks: Check milestone filters, details and new counts. Keep reported milestones distinct from verified placements.

focusCases.title: Impact · Exports
focusCases.checks: Download an authorized test CSV and verify scope, headers, consent restrictions and dates.

focusCases.title: Partner members · Return context
focusCases.checks: Filter by stage and search on phone and desktop, open a member, then return with the same list.
